PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Nudge whole grids one block at a time in creative, and merge a locked grid into the grid it touches
PluginData.Description:
Move a grid by exactly one block without copy and paste.
Ctrl + Numpad 8 / 2 / 4 / 6: forward, back, left, right Ctrl + Numpad 9 / 3: up, down Ctrl + Numpad 5: lock onto the grid you are looking at, or unlock Ctrl + Numpad 0: auto-merge on or off
Directions follow the camera, snapped to the grid's axes, and stay fixed for 5 seconds after the last move so turning around does not swap them. Rotor, piston and hinge subgrids move with the grid. A move into another grid is refused. With auto-merge on, a locked grid merges into an aligned grid of the same size as soon as it touches it, like a merge block.
NumLock must be on. Single player only, in creative mode or with creative tools enabled.
